title: ED wait observation
description: One facility/metric observation in a collection batch. Applies to each JSON line in s3://mem-ed-wait-times/raw/ed_wait/ and in decompressed compacted/ed_wait/ objects. Derived from mem-ed-lambda.py and checked against 1,960 sampled records on 2026-09-11. See s3-buckets.md for layout, provenance, and reading rules.
$comment: This schema describes the current producer's six-field record. It does not validate complete JSONL files, enforce record uniqueness, or establish historical coverage. Facility and metric values remain open to upstream changes. Date-time format checking must be enabled in validators that treat format as annotation.

facility.description: Facility slug supplied to the upstream API as the fac parameter. Current configured values are listed in s3-buckets.md.

metric.description: Metric key from the upstream API response. All inspected records use CV_ED_Wait, but the producer accepts other keys. The repository does not define its precise clinical meaning.

wait_minutes.description: Upstream metric value converted with Python int(), in minutes. The producer defines no bounds or sentinel meanings. Zero is present in sampled data.

observed_at.description: Observation timestamp captured after the facility HTTP response succeeds. The producer writes ISO 8601 UTC with a +00:00 offset and fractional seconds when present. This is collection time, not an upstream event timestamp.

batch_id.description: Collection start timestamp shared by all records in a batch, written as ISO 8601 UTC with a +00:00 offset. Its UTC date determines the dt partition; its time at second precision determines the raw object filename. This is not a UUID.

latency_ms.description: Python Requests response.elapsed.total_seconds() multiplied by 1000 and rounded, in milliseconds. This measures the facility HTTP request through response headers, not the complete collection batch or a patient wait.
